plan.rationale: Candidate f600513f (bundle trial-43f18a5360-param-2586708b, additive legacy binding, functional_sites=2, framework_fallbacks=0) failed parameter screening solely on step_ms (249.803 vs limit 144.803; original reference 137.908) with parameters {}: an +81% step regression on both ranks while rank-1 communication_kernel_sum_ms is unchanged vs the original (63.819 vs 63.672) and only rank 0 rose (80.530 vs 63.316), so the max-rank objective inflation is rank-0 sided. Parent discovery shows 13 SUM allreduces (12x 28,351,488 B + 1x 157,541,376 B, Float, world 2, stream 17) with identical ncclDevKernel_AllReduce_Sum_f32_RING_LL entry names on both ranks but rank-0 durations ~13.4-14.3 ms vs rank-1 ~3.6 ms for identical payloads, plus a 156.29 ms first collective on rank 0 only - indicating in-kernel waiting/arrival skew or delayed host submission rather than wire or algorithm cost; bucket-to-collective identity is already resolved per collective from observed gradient-storage membership, and the torch trace left 208 ambiguous forward sequences. Selected collectors, each tied to one open question on this exact candidate: binding_cost isolates the additive legacy binding overhead in clean AB/BA parent-vs-binding-only-passthrough workers (applicable: an additive candidate exists and bundles do not replace the parent) to test whether the empty-parameter step regression is binding-induced; execution_timeline locates the +112 ms via CPU-to-CUDA submit associations, synchronization events and per-device intervals, including whether collective submissions are issued late, with passive post-accumulate callbacks placing bucket allreduces (CPU-submission clock bounds only); nsys, available per request.json tools, supplies a merged cross-rank timeline to attribute the rank-0 kernel inflation to arrival skew and compute/communication overlap and to resolve residual forward-sequence attribution ambiguity (it will not be treated as separating NCCL waiting from wire transfer or as proving bucket identity); nccl_tuning captures the actual NCCL algorithm/protocol/channel decisions in a separate warmed worker for the observed 28,351,488 B and 157,541,376 B f32 allreduces, since the RING_LL kernel entry name does not identify the protocol and protocol regime is the main lever candidate parameters could reach; collective_calibration runs the clean warmed full-world SUM allreduce at exactly the observed sizes/dtypes as a reference experiment to test whether in-step kernel durations are algorithm cost (reference only, not a lower bound or critical-path estimate). Excluded: torch (already ran); device_telemetry (device-wide native-window PCIe/utilization readings cannot be attributed per collective and rank-1 comm is unchanged, so the fabric is not implicated); python_runtime (perturbs execution, inclusive/self times are not clean scores, and host attribution is covered at whole-invocation and timeline level by binding_cost + execution_timeline); candidate_diagnostics (no capability or trace evidence supplied for it).
